purpose: Primary-source support and claim boundaries for the exploratory fixed-time gait dynamics restart.

sources.title: Computer Vision for Clinical Gait Analysis: A Gait Abnormality Video Dataset
sources.version: IEEE Access related DOI; arXiv v1 submitted 2024-07-05
sources.access: Abstract and linked publication material inspected.
sources.supports: Public-video gait annotations and the reported 1,874-sequence dataset.
sources.does_not_support: Patient identity verification in the local derivative or clinical generalization of the restart.

sources.title: Kinematic determinants of human locomotion
sources.supports: Structured intersegmental covariation in laboratory gait.
sources.does_not_support: Equivalence of video coordinates to measured three-dimensional segment angles or neural states.

sources.title: A new measure for quantifying the bilateral coordination of human gait: effects of aging and Parkinson's disease
sources.access: Indexed primary abstract inspected; a later direct open returned an incomplete shell.
sources.supports: Clinical relevance of bilateral gait timing.
sources.does_not_support: Calling a video context-control score the phase coordination index or a basal-ganglia measurement.

sources.title: Merging of Healthy Motor Modules Predicts Reduced Locomotor Performance and Muscle Coordination Complexity Post-Stroke
sources.access: Primary abstract and author-hosted manuscript inspected; one later PDF request timed out.
sources.supports: Association between altered EMG modular organization and locomotor impairment after stroke.
sources.does_not_support: Recovering neural modules from this study's 2D poses or assigning a universal prediction-error direction.

sources.title: Muscle synergies and complexity of neuromuscular control during gait in cerebral palsy
sources.access: Author-hosted paper and indexed primary abstract inspected.
sources.supports: Reduced EMG synergy complexity in cerebral palsy and association with impairment.
sources.does_not_support: Equating low-dimensional pose prediction with a directly measured motor-control mechanism.

sources.title: S-JEPA: A Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Skeletal Action Recognition
sources.access: Conference PDF inspected, including masking, target, loss, and training details.
sources.supports: Published latent masked-skeleton prediction architecture and action-recognition evaluation.
sources.does_not_support: Faithful reproduction by the local compact model or clinical future-state simulation.

sources.title: On human motion prediction using recurrent neural networks
sources.access: Primary abstract inspected; current arXiv author spelling retained.
sources.supports: Need for strong static motion-prediction baselines.
sources.does_not_support: Any numeric expectation for the GAVD restart.

sources.title: Multimodal Motion Conditioned Diffusion Model for Skeleton-based Video Anomaly Detection
sources.supports: Prior work on future skeleton generation for anomaly detection.
sources.does_not_support: Direct numerical comparison with a clinical gait cohort.

sources.title: GenGait: A Transformer-Based Model for Human Gait Anomaly Detection and Normative Twin Generation
sources.version: arXiv v2; source record describes a journal-submitted preprint
sources.access: Current arXiv abstract inspected; separate PubMed DOI record not used to infer full publication details.
sources.supports: Prior normal-only gait reconstruction and normative-twin work.
sources.does_not_support: Clinical validation of reconstruction on all pathological conditions or causal treatment counterfactuals.

sources.title: BioGait-VLM: A Tri-Modal Vision-Language-Biomechanics Framework for Interpretable Clinical Gait Assessment
sources.access: Primary abstract and HTML article inspected.
sources.supports: Recent biomechanics-informed gait assessment and explicit concern with environmental shortcuts.
sources.does_not_support: Transfer of the paper's claimed subject-disjoint status to the local GAVD derivative.

sources.title: The First Workshop on Medical World Models at AAAI-27
sources.supports: Workshop scope, extended deadline, page limits, formatting, and review status.
sources.does_not_support: Acceptance probability or independent confirmation of the live OpenReview invitation deadline.
